title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.13574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. translated_title: 基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的高维金融回归 $L_0$ 特征选择
translated_abstract: 特征选择是高维金融回归中的核心问题，大量工程化变量以及预测变量之间的强相关性会降低模型的稳定性和可解释性。$L_1$ 正则化（Lasso）被广泛用于稀疏回归，但当有效信号分散在相互关联的变量之间时，其收缩效应可能具有局限性。精确稀疏回归可以避免这种收缩，但需要求解一个计算上非常困难的组合优化问题，且通常以最小化样本内误差而非样本外误差为目标进行拟合。本文提出了一种基于带广义嵌套 Rollout 策略自适应的蒙特卡洛树搜索的特征选择框架。特征选择被表述为一个序贯决策过程，候选特征子集依据其样本外验证性能而非训练误差进行评分。该方法还支持字典序……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于广义嵌套 Rollout 策略自适应蒙特卡洛树搜索（GNRPA）的 $L_0$ 特征选择框架，将特征选择建模为以样本外验证性能为评分准则的序贯决策过程，从而克服 Lasso 收缩偏差与精确稀疏回归计算困难的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an $L_0$ feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA), which formulates feature selection as a sequential decision process scored by out-of-sample validation performance, overcoming the shrinkage bias of Lasso and the computational intractability of exact sparse regression.
